description_en: Generates an activation code for the lightweight edition
description_zh: 生成轻量化版本激活码
name: CreateActivationCode

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud order ID, including virtual order IDs. If you use a virtual order, you can call CreateOrGetVirtualLicenseOrder and specify the Engine parameter to obtain the returned AliyunOrderId
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云订单 ID（含虚拟订单 ID）。如使用虚拟订单，可先调用 CreateOrGetVirtualLicenseOrder，指定 Engine 获取其返回的 AliyunOrderId
parameters.name: aliyun_order_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the database. This field is required if the AllowEmptySystemIdentifier parameter of the order is set to false
parameters.help_zh: 数据库唯一标志。如果订单的 AllowEmptySystemIdentifier 为 false，则该字段为必填
parameters.name: system_identifier

parameters.help_en: The description of the activation code
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the activation code. The name can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). This name is used to generate the activation code file name when you download the code from the console
parameters.help_zh: 激活码的名称，仅允许使用英文、数字、下划线、中划线命名，方便控制台下载时生成激活码文件名称
parameters.name: name

CertContentB64.description_en: The content of the activation code. Decode the Base64-encoded content and save it to the license.lic file for PolarDB to read during startup
CertContentB64.description_zh: 激活码内容，将这个内容 base64 解码存入到 license.lic 后供 PolarDB 启动时读取
CertContentB64.title_en: 激活码内容，将这个内容 base64 解码存入到 license.lic 后供 PolarDB 启动时读取
CertContentB64.title_zh: 激活码内容，将这个内容 base64 解码存入到 license.lic 后供 PolarDB 启动时读取

Description.description_en: The description of the activation code

ExpireAt.description_en: The time when the activation code expires

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the activation code was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the activation code was updated

Id.description_en: The ID of the activation code

Name.description_en: The name of the activation code

SystemIdentifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the database, also known as the system identifier
SystemIdentifier.description_zh: 数据库唯一标志 System Identifier
SystemIdentifier.title_en: 数据库唯一标志 System Identifier
SystemIdentifier.title_zh: 数据库唯一标志 System Identifier
